items.resolution: Generated image sample counts and WAV lengths are checked against their declared bounds; invalid sizes are refused before success publication.
items.probe: What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate?

items.resolution: Metadata uses validated bounded fields; CLI errors must remain complete and must not silently truncate into a success message.
items.probe: What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow?

items.resolution: Missing input, required symbols, completion or pixel data cause unsuccessful refusal and publish no success artifacts.
items.probe: What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media?

items.resolution: Artifacts are finalized only after validation and guest completion; no partial artifact is presented as success.
items.probe: What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)?

items.resolution: Refusal identifies the failed check and exits unsuccessfully without success artifacts.
items.probe: What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)?

items.resolution: Successful output is an exact unscaled diagnostic P3 SNAPSHOT with identity/tick/startup/profile/palette metadata and a valid labelled silence WAV.
items.probe: What does the normal populated (happy-path) state look like at a typical volume of content?
